bug_description: (1) start is accepted while busy, restarting the running operation (moderate); (2) the final-step negation of the multiplicand is done in 8 bits, so -(-128) wraps to -128 and a=-128 with negative b gives the wrong sign (subtle extreme value); (3) done is only cleared by the next start, so it stays high after the completion cycle instead of pulsing (subtle).
